description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git checkout -m' during conflict resolution and merge scenarios. It sets up a git repository, performs various merges and conflict resolutions, and verifies that the checkout command restores conflicted files as expected.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the initial git repository state with commits and branches for the tests.

methods.name: clean_branchnames
methods.description: Removes branch names after conflict markers in files to prepare for comparison.
